limits: Diameter and nominal kgf tension are transcribed from the photograph. Nominal tension is interpreted at 650 mm and standard tuning, which the photograph does not independently confirm.
Plain-string effective linear mass is inferred from nominal tension and target frequency with assumed bending stiffness; it is not a measured nylon bulk density.

Wound core/wire diameters are inferred from outer diameter and nominal tension using a single close-packed round copper winding and freely sliding nylon filaments. These internal dimensions are not product specifications.
One active string per generated note; five other strings contribute mean preload. Polyphony mixes independently calculated voices, without dynamic sympathetic coupling among six strings.
Inherited whole-shell acoustic high-frequency accuracy limits still apply. No claim of reproducing a real 520R set or a specific guitar.
Fretted notes shorten the active speaking length with the inherited nut-body port; finger damping and a spatially moved fret contact are not modeled.
High-frequency acoustic reduction is inherited from latest B, including its unresolved 3500 Hz error. State/Schur agreement verifies assembly, not continuum accuracy.
